working_definition: Cyst cells of the adult testis, branch a of a two-branch pair in the cyst cell lineage; no further stage or marker description. Authors had no FBbt term (Manual Annotation).

best_match.fbbt_definition: One of a pair of somatic cells that envelope each cyst of developing male germline cells.

justification: FBbt has no term for a cyst cell lineage branch; the cell type named is a testis cyst cell, so the generic cyst cell of testis is the level the authors commit to. No adult-specific variant exists.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: A cyst cell that is a part of a spermatogonial cyst.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Stage not stated by the authors for this branch.

recommendation: Broad match to cyst cell of testis.
